SELECT /*LGVATT50030.retrieveAttendanceLeave*/ curr.time_and_attendance_yyyymm , ep.employee_no , ep.employee_name , ep.employee_grade , ep.org_name_local , ep.date_hire_subsidiary , TO_CHAR(NVL(prev.residual_annual_leave_days, 0), 'FM9990.0') AS prev_year_carr_fwd_days -- 전년이월 (Accumulationfrom Last Year) , TO_CHAR(NVL(curr.curr_month_accu_creation_days, 0), 'FM9990.0') AS curr_year_accu_creation_days -- 당년누적생성 (Create at This Year) , TO_CHAR(NVL(prev.residual_annual_leave_days, 0) + NVL(curr.curr_month_accu_creation_days, 0), 'FM9990.0') AS total_creation_days , TO_CHAR(NVL(curr.curr_month_use_days, 0), 'FM9990.0') AS curr_month_use_days -- 당월사용 (Used Annual Leave at This Month) , TO_CHAR(NVL(curr.total_use_days, 0), 'FM9990.0') AS total_use_days -- 당년 총 사용 , TO_CHAR(NVL(curr.total_residual_days, 0), 'FM9990.0') AS total_residual_days -- 총잔여 (Remained Annual Leave of This Year) FROM ( SELECT tal.employee_no ,emp.full_name_local AS employee_name ,lcc.common_code_desc AS employee_grade ,emp.org_name_local ,TO_CHAR(emp.date_hire_subsidiary, 'DD/MM/YYYY') as date_hire_subsidiary FROM tb_att_annual_leave_n tal ,emp_master emp ,lgcom_common_code_c lcc WHERE tal.employee_no = emp.employee_number AND emp.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND emp.grade_title = lcc.common_code AND lcc.code_type_code = 'IF_VIETNAM_GRADE_TITLE' AND emp.flsa_yn = 'N' AND emp.fse_yn = 'N'
AND emp.organization_id = #{orgName}
AND emp.organization_id IN ( SELECT to_char(tac.organization_id) FROM tb_att_contract_n tac WHERE tac.time_attend_contact_user_id = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.employeeNo} AND SYSDATE BETWEEN tac.effective_start_date AND nvl(tac.effective_end_date, to_date('9999-12-31', 'yyyy-mm-dd')) UNION SELECT om.organization_id FROM org_master om WHERE SYSDATE BETWEEN om.org_start_date AND NVL(om.org_end_date, to_date('9999-12-31', 'yyyy-mm-dd')) AND om.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS master_count FROM lgcom_user_role_n lur ,lgcom_user_m lum WHERE lur.application_user_id = lum.application_user_id AND lum.user_name = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.employeeNo} AND role_code = 'VN_ATT_MASTER_USER') > 0 )
AND tal.employee_no like '%' || UPPER(#{employeeNo})
AND UPPER(emp.full_name_local) like '%' || UPPER(#{employeeName}) || '%'
AND emp.date_hire_subsidiary BETWEEN TRUNC(TO_DATE(#{hireStartDate},'DD/MM/YYYY')) AND TRUNC(TO_DATE(#{hireEndDate},'DD/MM/YYYY')+1)
AND tal.time_and_attendance_yyyymm = #{timeAndAttendanceYyyymm} ORDER BY tal.employee_no ) ep ,(SELECT employee_no ,#{timeAndAttendanceYyyymm} AS time_and_attendance_yyyymm -- 년월 , TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(MAX(time_and_attendance_yyyymm), 'YYYYMM'), -12), 'YYYY') || '12' AS prev_dec_yyyymm -- 전년12월 , NVL(SUM(NVL(occur_basic_annual_leave_days, 0) + NVL(occur_monthly_ann_lv_days, 0) + NVL(annual_calibration_days, 0)), 0) AS curr_month_accu_creation_days -- 당월누적 생성일수 , NVL(SUM(NVL(use_annual_leave_days, 0)), 0) AS total_use_days -- 총 사용일수 , NVL(MAX(DECODE(time_and_attendance_yyyymm, #{timeAndAttendanceYyyymm}, use_annual_leave_days, 0)), 0) AS curr_month_use_days -- 당월 사용일수 , NVL(MAX(DECODE(time_and_attendance_yyyymm, #{timeAndAttendanceYyyymm}, NVL(residual_annual_leave_days, 0) + NVL(annual_compensation_days, 0), 0)), 0) AS total_residual_days -- 총 남은일수 FROM tb_att_annual_leave_n WHERE subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND time_and_attendance_yyyymm BETWEEN SUBSTR(#{timeAndAttendanceYyyymm}, 1, 4) || '01' AND #{timeAndAttendanceYyyymm} GROUP BY employee_no ) curr , tb_att_annual_leave_n prev WHERE curr.employee_no = ep.employee_no AND curr.employee_no = prev.employee_no(+) AND curr.prev_dec_yyyymm = prev.time_and_attendance_yyyymm(+) ORDER BY ep.employee_no asc
